comments.body:
⚠️ severity: IMPORTANT —
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: `--validate` is documented as "the CI lint" but is never wired into CI — a broken entry lands green and reds the release train at cut time**

Two places of this PR promise PR-time entry validation:

- `docs/agents/commits-releases.md:213` — "`--validate` is the CI lint";
- `scripts/gen_changelog.dart` header — "`--validate` validate every entry
  (frontmatter schema, filename convention, non-empty body) — CI
  static-gate input".

But the new `static` job (this hunk) runs only
`scripts/check_changelog_entry.py`, which checks the **filename pattern**
(`ENTRY_RE`) plus archive immutability and CHANGELOG byte-equality. The
byte-equality path runs `gen_changelog.dart --write-changelog` (which would
surface frontmatter errors) **only when the diff touches `CHANGELOG.md`** —
a normal PR adds just an entry file, so a malformed entry (unknown/missing
`type:`, empty body, unterminated frontmatter) passes CI green, merges, and
then fails the release train at cut time (`release_notes.sh` exits 1 on the
aggregation) — the expensive, late failure this change set out to prevent.

Fix: one line in this step —

```yaml
run: |
  python3 scripts/check_changelog_entry.py --self-test
  python3 scripts/check_changelog_entry.py
  dart scripts/gen_changelog.dart --validate
```

—and extend the wiring pin at `test/ci_changelog_entry_guard_test.dart:226`
to assert the ci.yml step carries the validate run.

comments.author: ai-teammate
comments.body:
⚠️ severity: IMPORTANT —
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: an entry file ending at the closing `---` (no trailing newline) passes validation and publishes raw frontmatter into the release notes**

`scripts/gen_changelog.dart:185`:

```dart
final body = text.substring(text.indexOf('\n', close + 1) + 1).trim();
```

When the file's frontmatter close is the **last line without a trailing
newline** (i.e. the file is exactly `---\ntype: fix\nissue: 99\n---`),
`text.indexOf('\n', close + 1)` returns `-1`, `substring(0)` takes the
**whole file**, and the "body" becomes the frontmatter text itself.
Reproduced locally against this branch:

```
$ printf -- '---\ntype: fix\nissue: 99\n---' > changelog/entries/99-no-newline.md
$ dart scripts/gen_changelog.dart --validate
changelog entries: 1 file(s) valid (1 issue-keyed)   # exit 0
$ dart scripts/gen_changelog.dart --stdout

comments.author: ai-teammate
comments.body:
💡 severity: SUGGESTION —
💡 **SUGGESTION: `--validate` accepts a body with zero bullet lines, breaking the flat-bullets notes shape the AC2 parity test pins**

The documented entry contract (docs, generator header, PR description) is
"frontmatter + **1–3 user-facing bullet lines**", and the flat aggregate's
byte-parity with the old curated `## Unreleased` body is pinned as
all-`- ` bullets (`test/changelog_gen_test.dart` AC2 parity compares bullet
sets). But the validator only requires the body to be **non-empty**; a
prose body with no `- ` lines passes `--validate` and lands bullet-less in
the release-notes body, silently diverging from the pinned shape.

At `scripts/gen_changelog.dart:209` you already count bullets:

```dart
final bullets = body.split('\n').where((l) => l.startsWith('- ')).length;
```

Make `bullets == 0` an `EntryProblem` ("body must be 1–3 `- ` bullet
lines") and pin both directions (0 bullets → red, 4 bullets → warn) in the
`--validate` test group. Cheap to add while you're touching the validator
for the no-trailing-newline fix anyway.

comments.author: ai-teammate
comments.body:
⚠️ **IMPORTANT fixed — `--validate` is wired into the ci.yml static job (commit `1eb9f7b5fa`)**

The `Changelog entries guard (gh-2463)` step now runs the documented CI lint:

```yaml
run: |
  python3 scripts/check_changelog_entry.py --self-test
  python3 scripts/check_changelog_entry.py
  if [ -d changelog/entries ]; then
    dart scripts/gen_changelog.dart --validate
  else
    echo "no changelog/entries/ dir (nothing pending) — entry validation skipped"
  fi
```

One deliberate deviation from the literal one-liner in the thread: the validate run is gated on the entries dir existing. Reason: consumed-entry housekeeping legitimately removes the LAST pending entry after a tag cut, and git drops an emptied directory — on that arm (and any `no-changelog` PR merged in that window) the unconditional `--validate` would exit 1 on `changelog/entries/ does not exist` and false-red the static job. The gate loses nothing the thread asks for: any PR that adds or carries entry files (i.e. every case where a broken entry can exist) runs the full validator at PR time — unknown/missing `type:`, empty/bullet-less body, unterminated frontmatter, and the no-trailing-newline case now red the PR instead of the release train. Same fail-safe direction as `scripts/release_notes.sh` preference 1b (`[ -d changelog/entries ]`).

Wiring pin extended: `test/ci_changelog_entry_guard_test.dart` gained `ci.yml static job wires 'gen_changelog.dart --validate' as the lint`, asserting both the validate invocation and the dir gate are present in ci.yml (RED first — it failed on the pre-fix branch; GREEN after the wiring). Verified locally: `dart scripts/gen_changelog.dart --validate` on the repo tree → `changelog entries: 1 file(s) valid (1 issue-keyed)`, exit 0.

comments.author: ai-teammate
comments.body:
⚠️ **IMPORTANT fixed — the no-trailing-newline frontmatter case is now a structural problem (commit `1eb9f7b5fa`)**

`scripts/gen_changelog.dart` (`_parseEntry`) no longer blind-`substring`s past the frontmatter close:

```dart
final bodyStart = text.indexOf('\n', close + 1);
if (bodyStart < 0) {
  problems.add(
    EntryProblem(name, 'no body after the frontmatter close — the file '
        'ends at `---`; add a blank line + 1–3 `- ` bullet lines after it'),
  );
  return null;
}
final body = text.substring(bodyStart + 1).trim();
```

The reviewer's exact repro now fails loudly in both directions:

```
$ printf -- '---\ntype: fix\nissue: 99\n---' > changelog/entries/99-no-newline.md
$ dart scripts/gen_changelog.dart --validate
::error::99-no-newline.md: no body after the frontmatter close — the file ends at `---`; add a blank line + 1–3 `- ` bullet lines after it   # exit 1
$ dart scripts/gen_changelog.dart --stdout
::error::99-no-newline.md: no body after the frontmatter close — …          # exit 1
gen_changelog: 1 broken entry file(s) — run `dart scripts/gen_changelog.dart --validate` for the full list
```

The aggregate modes stop loudly too (they already exit 1 on any `EntryProblem`), so the raw `---\ntype: fix\nissue: 99\n---` block can no longer reach `release_notes.sh` preference 1b or the published release page — the "fails loudly instead of shipping silently" contract holds.

Regression pin (TDD RED→GREEN): `frontmatter close at EOF (no trailing newline) fails loudly` in the `--validate` red-path group of `test/changelog_gen_test.dart` — asserts exit 1 + `::error::` + the message, and that `--stdout` refuses and prints no `type: fix`. It failed on the pre-fix branch (exit 0) exactly as the thread reproduced.

**Summary**: The PR's design is sound (per-entry changelog files, generated index, byte-parity pinned by tests; committed CHANGELOG.md verified byte-identical to regenerated output) but its own CI is red: the similarity gate fails on 19 near-duplicate files this PR adds. 🚨 severity: BLOCKING —
🚨 **BLOCKING: Red CI — the similarity (duplication) gate fails on this PR's own new files**

The `CRAP + duplication` job is red on commit `f3cc5b9c` (run 46138697254):

```
[FAIL] similarity: 19 files in 9 similar-file clusters (3335 scanned)
  CHANGELOG.md: similar to changelog/entries/2463-changelog-entries.md —
    near-duplicate content (jaccard 0.13, containment 0.90)
  changelog/archive/1.0.510.md: similar to changelog/archive/1.0.511.md —
    near-duplicate content (jaccard 0.33, containment 0.99)
Gates: 3 passed, 1 failed, 1 warned, 22 skipped  → exit 2
```

These are **by-design** near-duplicates this migration creates: the generated
`CHANGELOG.md` index shares its preamble/bullets with the entry file that
produced it, and adjacent migrated archive sections (e.g. `1.0.510.md` ↔
`1.0.511.md`) are nearly identical verbatim copies. The gate has an explicit
escape hatch for exactly this class — `crap4dart.yaml:223` `exclude:` with the
documented pattern "BY-DESIGN twins — excluded via glob per gh-1738 AC2, never
baselined" (used for `firebase_options.template.dart` and gen-l10n outputs) —
but `changelog/**` was never added to it.

Fix direction (author's call): add globs for the generated index and the
verbatim-migrated archive bodies to the `similarity.exclude` list in
`crap4dart.yaml` with that same justification comment (exclude, never a
baseline — a baseline entry would silently mask edits to these files). Then
re-run the gate; CI must be green before merge.
